messages:
maria.dev: heads up — master CI is failing on the kafka-integrations suite, looks like SSL handshake errors hitting mock-kafka across multiple jobs. https://ci.redwood.example/teams/infra/pipelines/4567/jobs/7890

maria.dev: snippet from job 7890 artifact:
```
javax.net.ssl.SSLHandshakeException: Received fatal alert: handshake_failure
    at sun.security.ssl.Alert.createSSLException(Alert.java:131)
    ...
Caused by: java.security.cert.CertificateException: No subject alternative names present
```

sam.ops: ack, looking. @ci-bot can you rerun the failed jobs?

ci-bot: Re-run queued for jobs 7890, 7891, 7892 — triggered by sam.ops

jonathan: two jobs on PR #1983 also failed with same error, adding links to artifacts.

maria.dev: suspect mock-kafka cert rotation yesterday. eng-infra pushed a test CA change. @ryan any config push you recognize?

ryan: yes — rotated test CA at 2026-03-16T22:10Z and updated truststores for most mocks, probably missed mock-kafka. Pushing a targeted fix now.

ryan: quick question — do we want a temporary workaround in CI (skip verify) or roll back the mock-kafka cert?

sam.ops: please don't disable TLS verify globally. Rollback the mock-kafka image to pre-rotation tag if possible.

ryan: rolling back registry tag now: mock-kafka:stable -> mock-kafka:pre-cert-rot-20260316

ci-bot: Deploy triggered to test infra: rolling update mock-kafka (3 replicas)

infra-bot: healthchecks: pod mock-kafka-1 CrashLoopBackOff (OOM on startup) — investigating logs.

maria.dev: if the rollback takes >15m and master remains blocked, should we consider temporarily excluding kafka-integration from the critical suite? Not ideal but stops the merge queue.

sam.ops: opened a WIP PR to gate the kafka tests out of the fast path: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-tests/pull/254 (WIP)

jonathan: can someone drop the failing job links here? I want to bisect locally against our test harness.

maria.dev: added the artifacts for 7890/7891/7892 and the PR failures: https://ci.redwood.example/artifacts/7890.log, https://ci.redwood.example/artifacts/7891.log

ryan: fixed image pushed as mock-kafka:fix-1937770000. New image uses the old cert bundle + a guard to auto-load new truststores.

ci-bot: Job 7890 rerun completed — SUCCESS. Job 7891 — SUCCESS. Job 7892 — FAILED (unrelated: rate-limiter timeout in test harness).

maria.dev: great, thanks. Monitoring for another 30m to see if any fresh failures pop up.

sam.ops: follow-up action — create a checklist & automation around test CA rotations (update truststores for all mocks + run smoke). Filing ticket.

sam.ops: ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1123

maria.dev: noted. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Thread archived after 2h of inactivity.
